headline: Getafe vs Rayo: flat derby, small lean to fewer goals
summary: The market sees a near coin-flip derby. Rayo Vallecano are marginal favourites at 36.2% fair, with the draw at 33.1% and Getafe at 30.7% — all inside 1.5 percentage points of noise. The one genuine thread is goals: Over 2.0 fair fell from 49.4% to 46.7% at the sharp market, and the fair total slid from 1.98 to 1.90. Both teams to score Yes sits at 43.0%, which is the same goals information rather than independent confirmation. Getafe's injury list runs to seven names, all now showing as no longer listed, so it reads as rotation noise. AH Home +0 is flat at 45.8% fair.
